title: pehria compacta
intro: Pehria compacta, commonly known as the compact pehria or pehria, is a type of plant that belongs to the family of flowering plants, specifically the Pehriaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of pehria compacta are attributed to its ability to reduce stress, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of pehria compacta include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
